meta.name: Monster of the Week
meta.notes: Seat limits are decision D3 (3.16). Rules: the first draft (Appendix G) as amended in section 3. Cards: the core deck, the 21 cards here. Numbers: first-draft guesses (G.7), each a variant. Map: the prototype board, layout D (testing only).

slayerGroups.name: AV Club
slayerGroups.trope: Teen hackers and computer club nerds

slayerGroups.name: Father and the Flock
slayerGroups.trope: A parish exorcist and reluctant helpers

cards.name: Invite Them In
cards.text: Two groups of different factions next door are invited into an empty location. Target: where they’re invited.

readings.location: an empty ◐ location; any two groups next to it.
readings.faction: a location held by a lone group of another faction, next to a Nocturnal group: only the Nocturnals come.

cards.name: The Gate
cards.text: Join two locations for the rest of the round: they count as a single location for movement, and fight as one (strength and sway added across both; a true tie scorches both). Each end is an ↂ location or a location holding the Sci-Fi faction; never three factions across them. Only 1 sway, at one end. Target: the two ends.

readings.location: either end: an ↂ location, or a location holding the Sci-Fi faction.
readings.faction: either end: a location holding the Sci-Fi faction, or an ↂ location.

cards.name: Spoof the Signal
cards.text: The AV Club spoofs a command signal to a group: ordered to engage the strongest hostile force in range, it marches on the largest lone group of another faction within two locations of it (ties: your choice). Target: the group fooled.

cards.name: Bait the Herd
cards.text: Lay a trail of bait: a group follows it from neighbour to neighbour, picking up its own kind at every stop and leaving nothing behind. It stops where you choose, or crashes into a lone group of another faction. Target: the herd.

cards.name: Perform the Ritual
cards.text: Father and the Flock begin the rite, and one faction next door is drawn to it: every group of it comes, whole if it’s alone, as many as you choose if it’s in a fight. The centre is empty or holds one faction. Target: the centre, then the faction called.

readings.location: a ⎈ location; any faction is called.
readings.faction: any location next to the Demon faction; the Demons are called.

cards.name: Draw Them Away
cards.text: The Watch sets out distractions all round the location, and one of the dead shambles off to check each. A group sends 1 token to each of at least two neighbours; the rest stay. Target: the group.

cards.name: The Big Chase
cards.text: The Kids on Bikes lead a group on a chase from neighbour to neighbour, across any region, through empty ground, lone rivals, its own kind and fights it’s part of. Every location it passes keeps 1 token; the rest, at least 1, arrive wherever you end it. Target: the group chased.

readings.location: a group at an ↂ location.

cards.name: Cut the Powerlines
cards.text: The AV Club cuts the powerlines. A group scatters to its faction’s other groups anywhere on the island, 1 token at a time: no group gets a second until every group has one. A lone group leaves entirely; from a fight, exactly half. Target: the group.

cards.name: Plough Through
cards.text: The Slayerettes plough a truck straight through the middle of the brawl. Every side leaves by half, rounded up, split as you choose among its neighbours, never two sides to the same location. Its sway is paid by the factions in the fight or the Nocturnals, split as you choose. Target: the fight.

readings.faction: a fight the Nocturnals are in.

cards.name: Light of the Cross
cards.text: The cross is raised and the target group falls back from its light, split evenly between two neighbours. A group of 1 can’t be split. Target: the group.

cards.name: Wake the Dead
cards.text: The Watch chases the fight into the old cemetery, and the dead rise: as many from the Undead supply as you choose, up to the card’s sway. At a ☾ location they rise as a group of their own, and if two factions are already fighting there, as a third side. Each one risen places 1 of your sway there. Target: where they rise.

readings.location: any ☾ location; at a fight there, the dead rise as a third side.
readings.faction: any location holding the Undead; the risen join them.

cards.name: Take Control
cards.text: The AV Club takes control of the machines and turns them on the enemy. At the target fight, spend your sway there, 1 for each, to cut down up to the card’s sway of a faction’s tokens there: you take them as trophies, and the sway spent goes back to your supply. Target: the fight, then the faction hit.

readings.location: any fight at a ⏏ location; you choose the faction hit.
readings.faction: any fight the Sentients are in; their rival is hit.

cards.name: Night Terrors
cards.text: The Slayerettes stir up terrors in the dark. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. When night falls, before the fights, at each mark you may make 1 token of a faction there flee to a neighbouring location it can enter; your sway from the mark may follow it. Target: the locations marked.

cards.name: Study the Bodies
cards.text: The Kids on Bikes sneak in after the fight to study the bodies. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, if you lead there, you also take 1 trophy from the runner-up’s pile. Target: the locations marked.

cards.name: Spill Blood on the Altar
cards.text: Father and the Flock spill blood on the altar. Mark up to the card’s sway of locations, 1 sway on each. This round, at a marked location’s fight, the winner loses as many as the loser. Target: the locations marked.

cards.name: Call in Favours
cards.text: Choose one. Sway: 1 sway from your supply at each of up to X fights. Standing: up to X standing with one faction, from your supply. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Raise the Stakes
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: take 1 standing from each of up to X factions, all into one. Sway: gather up to X of your sway from next door into one location. Tokens: up to X tokens of one faction come in from its groups next door, to a location where you have sway. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Cover Every Exit
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: move 1 standing from one faction to each of up to X others. Sway: send 1 of your sway from one location to each of up to X neighbours. Tokens: a group sends 1 token to each of up to X neighbours. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Showdown
cards.text: At a lone group, never a fight, burn your sway there, 1 for each token, to take that many of its tokens as your trophies. Burned sway goes back to your supply. Target: the group.

cards.name: Switch Allegiance
cards.text: Choose one. Standing: burn up to X standing with one faction to gain the same with another. Sway: move up to X of your sway from one location to any other. X is the cards in your hand, this one included.

cards.name: Steal Their Playbook
cards.text: Choose one. Theirs: play the last card played for its action this round as if it were yours. Yours: take back into your hand a card you played earlier this round.

variants.label: Presence threshold
variants.description: The invaders win if total presence is more than this (TH1). First-draft guess 20 (G.7).

variants.label: Growth threshold
variants.description: A lone faction with at least this many tokens at a location grows (GR1).

variants.label: Tokens per faction
variants.description: Each faction's tokens, board and supply together (G.7).

variants.label: Cubes per player
variants.description: Each player's sway cubes (G.7). 30 while the cards are designed: a bump from 20 so the supply rarely limits play (designer, 2026-10-07); the balancing number comes later.

variants.label: Starting sway
variants.description: Sway each slayer group starts with, with its linked faction (G.7). Designer (2026-10-07): start with more sway on the affinity faction; 5 is Claude’s suggested starting number (was 3), to measure.

variants.label: Starting standing with other factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each player starts with 1 sway with every faction other than their affinity faction. 0 was the first draft before.

variants.label: Starting sway on affinity locations
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-07): each slayer group starts with 1 sway on the board at each of its affinity locations (its archetype’s three), from its supply.

variants.label: Slayer groups
variants.description: How slayer groups are given out (G.7).

choices.label: Random
choices.description: Each seat draws a slayer group at random.

choices.label: Seat order
choices.description: Seats take slayer groups in spec order.

variants.label: Sway per move
variants.description: Test lever (sway economy, 2026-10-07): sway a move places at each destination, from standing with the faction moved (CA2).

variants.label: Growth on own ground
variants.description: AL3: a faction controlling one of its aligned locations grows 1 more there (designer: off 2026-10-21, back on by default 2026-10-24).

choices.label: On
choices.description: AL3 as first drafted: 1 more on its own aligned ground.

variants.label: A way back for factions
variants.description: Designer (2026-10-26), first draft: a suit card may be played to bring its faction back while it has no location with 2 or more of its tokens: up to the card's sway of its tokens at its suit locations or where it is, 1 standing with it each.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: No way back: a faction wiped out stays gone.

variants.label: Starting tokens
variants.description: SD1 (designer): how each faction's tokens start on its three aligned locations; 2 on each since 2026-10-21.

choices.label: 5, 1 and 1
choices.description: SD1 as first drafted: 5 on a random home location, 1 on each of the other two.

choices.label: 3 on each
choices.description: The first draft (designer, 2026-10-17): 3 on each of the three (45 in all).

choices.label: 2 on each
choices.description: SD1 (designer, 2026-10-21): 2 on each of the three (30 in all).

map.notes: Prototype board, layout D (the first draft's map; not a decision). Axial hex coordinates; directions E, NE, NW, W, SW, SE. Adjacent means hexes sharing a border. Mirror is the reflection across the lake.
